full_page.content:
Page 85 Cont.
July 29 Kenneth Provost - 9 - fell out of crib when ten months old and ever since has been quite abnormal - has had as many as 12 con- vultions in day ...
30 Robert J. Loranger - 24 - in Service since February 10th; not contented. Parents ask for prayers that God guide ....
30 Robert Salas - 7 - stricken yesterday with infantile par ...... Prayers asked for, speedy recovery - enrolled in Ser. Masses ....
1943, August
August
Aug. 1 Thanks ... Mrs. Lena Holbath - 65 -(at 910 Kirby)- Episcopelian; was quite hopeless according to Drs. - had every thing in way of sickness .... unable to walk. If she stood on her feet for a min- ute the sweat ran down her body. She turned to Mary the Bl. Mother of Jesus .... and in two days was able to go to store and church etc.
Page 86
Aug. 2 Baby Aloysius L. - 14 mo. - tuomer on brain - 3 weeks more to live. - from Tillsonburg Ontario. "Hopeless" - coming To-morrow - 160 miles. 3rd. phones ... "Imigration authorities refuse coming from Windsor. 4th. Here Today bright though some restless but smiled. Enrolled perpetually.
Theodore Stankiewicz - 34 - Ypsilanti - psycotic .... Mother asks for prayer that he be well enough to come home.
3 Marie Shirley Williams - 16 - fell on ice last January hurting her knee. It has been swollen ever since and looks and pains very threateningly - most likely sarcomic cancer! Enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc. John Wickham - 4 - slightely "mongolian' case ... Enrolled 2nd time for 5. that drulling may let up. Mrs. Eva Levine - Eyes ... and diabetis. Mrs. Lachman - hard hearing. Elaine Mc. Curdy - 16 -
Wm. Getling - 52 - married out of Church 18 yrs. - wife presbiter- ian ... drinking, etc, etc. Wife heart sick ... asks for prayers. - Enrolls him.
